title: The symmetric algebra of a finite free module is a polynomial ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge0$, and $F=R^{\oplus n}$ with standard basis $e_1,\dots,e_n$; let $\operatorname{Sym}_R(F)$ and $\iota_F:F\to\operatorname{Sym}_R(F)$ be the symmetric algebra of $F$ and its canonical $R$-linear map [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property]. Then the $R$-algebra homomorphism $\varphi:\operatorname{Sym}_R(F)\to R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ to the polynomial ring in $n$ variables with $\varphi(\iota_F(e_i))=x_i$ for $i=1,\dots,n$ (it exists and is unique by the universal property, applied to the $R$-linear map $F\to R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, $e_i\mapsto x_i$) is an isomorphism of $R$-algebras.
